# Docxodus

> A structure-aware OOXML toolkit that reads, renders, edits, diffs, and converts .docx files through a .NET library, WebAssembly/npm package, Python client, and CLI tools.

Built on one engine exposed as a .NET library, browser WASM module, npm/TypeScript package, Python client, and three CLIs. Main capabilities: structural comparison producing native Word tracked-changes redlines, high-fidelity DOCX-to-HTML rendering, and a markdown projection where every block carries a stable content-derived id for addressing. Architecture docs live under docs/architecture, including ir_diff_engine.md.

## Docs

- [Docxodus README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/README.md): Structure-aware OOXML engine for rendering, editing, diffing, and agent use of .docx across .NET, browser, Python, and CLI.
- [Individual Contributor License Agreement ("Agreement")](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/CLA.md): Contributor License Agreement terms for Docxodus, including definitions, licensing of contributions, and how to sign via the CLA bot.
- [Backend operation reconciliation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/history-backend.md): Storage-neutral backend producer for version history: input codec, decision records, CAS publication, conflicts, and replayable effects.
- [History clients and log-driven rendering](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/history-clients.md): Client bindings over host-supplied blob and head stores: request schema, operations list, export/import behavior, and log-driven rendering.
- [History controls (frontend)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/history-controls.md): Accessible frontend panel for browsing version history, previewing versions, downloading files, restoring, and handling retries without discarding drafts.
- [Portable history files (.NET)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/history-files.md): Using .docx and .docxhistory files in .NET: checkpoints, retry semantics, import validation, conflict handling, and head adapter requirements.
- [Shared history infrastructure validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/history-validation.md): Version model/fault fuzzing with DOCXODUS_HISTORY_FUZZ_SEEDS and DOCXODUS_HISTORY_FUZZ_STEPS overrides, oracle details, and recorded passing runs.
- [Named version history (.NET)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/history.md): DocxVersionHistory API for capturing, listing, comparing, restoring, and replaying DOCX versions, with blob/head store adapters and CAS guidance.
- [Docxodus npm Package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/npm-package.md): Installing the docxodus npm package and its browser-side features: comparison, move detection, HTML conversion, annotations, and structure APIs.
- [npm releases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/npm-releases.md): How the v* workflow stages docxodus and @docxodus/export for npm, version requirements, trusted publisher setup, and the 2FA approval steps.
- [OOXML Corner Cases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/ooxml_corner_cases.md): Catalog of Open XML edge cases where Word diverges from or the spec is ambiguous, covering numbering, footnotes, layout, theme colors, and…
- [Repo positioning and discoverability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/repo-positioning.md): Why the repo's self-description changed, with the recommended GitHub description, topics, and maintainer-set discoverability settings.

## Architecture

- [WmlComparer parity baseline — the last differential run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/wmlcomparer_parity_baseline/README.md): Frozen parity scoreboard outputs from the final differential run against live WmlComparer, kept as historical evidence.
- [Browser-LLM editing demo — design stub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/browser_llm_demo.md): Unimplemented design stub for an in-browser LLM redlining demo producing native tracked changes via markdown anchors.
- [Trimming and NativeAOT for the CLI binaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/cli_trimming_and_native_aot.md): Trimming and NativeAOT status for the redline, docx2html and docx2oc release binaries, with sizes and caveats.
- [Collaboration and version history](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/collaboration_and_version_history.md): Proposed shared design for collaboration and version history, implemented through stacked PRs starting with PackageChangeSet.
- [Comment Rendering in HTML Converter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/comment_rendering.md): How WmlToHtmlConverter renders Word comments in HTML using EndnoteStyle, Inline and Margin modes.
- [Custom Annotations Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/custom_annotations.md): Custom annotation system for marking text ranges with metadata, using bookmarks plus a Custom XML Part.
- [Deliverable verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/deliverable_verification.md): Final-delivery verification gate for DOCX bytes: entry points, report schema, and deterministic policy findings.
- [Verified delivery bundles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/delivery_bundle.md): Transport-neutral operation deriving document, render, and evidence artifacts from baseline and working snapshots, with manifest and policies.
- [Delivery change receipt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/delivery_change_receipt.md): Signed, hash-addressed JSON record binding delivery claims to checkable facts, plus an offline adversarial verifier.
- [Document IR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/document_ir.md): Shared immutable typed in-memory model of a DOCX replacing per-module private views; status, motivation, and normalization.
- [Agent-Facing DOCX Editing Server (MCP)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/docx_agent_server.md): Local MCP server letting AI agents open, edit, and save .docx files through intent-shaped tools over stdio.
- [DOCX to HTML Converter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/docx_converter.md): Architecture of WmlToHtmlConverter: pipeline stages, footnote rendering, entry points, and XHTML serialization.
- [DOCX Mutation API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/docx_mutation_api.md): The DocxSession write-side API for anchor-addressed DOCX edits, raw-XML escape hatch, and source/test locations.
- [DocxDiff vs LibreOffice — parity findings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/docxdiff_libreoffice_findings.md): Verification of DocxDiff against LibreOffice Compare Documents on a real contract, with harness, oracle stance, and fix log.
- [Editor block drag handles — design and shipped behaviour](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/editor_block_drag_handles.md): Design and shipped behaviour of editor block drag handles, including the required MoveBlock mutation and revision-view-aware rendering.
- [Full-fidelity inline formatting on block edit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/editor_inline_formatting_on_edit.md): Approved design for preserving all run properties on block edit via minimal prefix/suffix-diff with ReplaceTextAtSpan.
- [The Editor Surface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/editor_ui_surface.md): Reference for the in-browser editor's controls, layers, mountRibbon hosts, and screenshot-captured measurements.
- [Epic #435 acceptance smoke — agent-safe headless document editing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/epic_435_acceptance_smoke.md): Acceptance smoke for agent-safe headless editing via docxodus-mcp: inspect, preview, apply, retry, audit workflow and results.
- [Incremental Annotation Overlay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/incremental_annotation_overlay.md): Fast annotation add, remove, and visibility toggling on pre-converted HTML without re-running DOCX-to-HTML conversion.
- [IR Diff Engine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/ir_diff_engine.md): Structure-aware DOCX comparison via DocxDiff: edit scripts rendered as tracked changes, revision lists, or JSON.
- [IR-Powered DOCX Editor — Feasibility & PoC Design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/ir_editor_feasibility.md): Feasibility verdict and architecture for a browser DOCX editor built on the IR, with PoC results.
- [IR-Powered DOCX Editor — Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/ir_editor_roadmap.md): Sequenced milestones for the IR-powered editor: shipped MVP, ribbon, formatting controls, and next steps M3/M4.
- [Markdown Projection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/markdown_projection.md): Anchor-addressed Markdown rendering of DOCX for search, diff, and LLM-driven editing pipelines.
- [Native content controls](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/native_content_controls.md): How DocxSession enumerates, anchors, and mutates Word content controls (w:sdt) with strict envelope rules.
- [Native image session API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/native_images.md): Occurrence-oriented image API on DocxSession: listing image occurrences, capabilities, per-operation mutation support, and tracked-change modes.
- [OpenContracts Export Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/opencontracts_export.md): Exporting DOCX to OpenContracts format: OpenContractDocExport, PAWLS layout, annotations, and text extraction from all document parts.
- [Deterministic package manifests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/package_manifests.md): PackageManifestGenerator inspecting DOCX/OPC bytes: package identities, document facts, malformed-structure findings, and VerificationOps entry points.
- [Portable PageMap and page citations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/page_map.md): Versioned PageMap contract between renderer pagination and DocxSession: page boxes, fragments, anchorIds, and citation availability rules.
- [Paginated Headers and Footers Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/paginated_headers_footers.md): Per-page header/footer cloning during client-side pagination: Word's section header model, the registry strategy, and source files.
- [Portable document history](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/portable_history.md): Host-owned document persistence: checkpoints, version browsing, .docx and .docxhistory exports, and validated read-only archive import.
- [docx-scalpel — Python Wrapper for `DocxSession](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/python_docxodus.md): Design spec for the docx-scalpel Python wrapper preserving the in-memory DocxSession across calls, with wire-protocol and type-mapping rationale.
- [Redline reversibility proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/redline_reversibility_proof.md): Versioned verification proving Accept and Reject of generated redline revisions recover baseline and intendedFinal byte-exactly.
- [S-1 cover-page smoke test — editor feature build](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/s1_smoke_test_features.md): Smoke test drafting an SEC Form S-1 cover page in DocxEditor, listing editor gaps and engine surface added.
- [Semantic diff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/semantic_diff.md): SemanticDiff API reporting meaningful DOCX package changes as versioned JSON, with package inspection limits and public options.
- [Session op descriptions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/session_op_descriptions.md): Describing session ops once as JSON data, then checking and generating the seven hand-written transport layers against it.
- [Shared publication and backend reconciliation infrastructure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/shared_history_infrastructure.md): Storage-neutral durable publication, version-history fault fuzzing, and backend operation-stream reconciliation, with completion gates and no GUI.
- [Standalone paginated HTML and PDF export](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/standalone_paginated_export.md): Accepted design for the Node-only @docxodus/export companion package, schema-v1 contracts, digests, and compatibility boundaries.
- [Token-Stream Arrangement of Regions Without Block Correspondence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/token_stream_arrangement.md): Architecture decisions for DocxDiff's word-level token-stream region arrangement mode, including placement, reversibility, provenance, and cost.
- [Tracked Changes HTML Rendering - Design Document](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/tracked_changes.md): Design for rendering tracked changes in WmlToHtmlConverter HTML output: revision elements, settings extensions, HTML format, default CSS, and handlers.
- [UI Responsiveness Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/ui_responsiveness.md): Three-phase approach to unblocking the browser main thread from synchronous WASM work, starting with the double-requestAnimationFrame yielding pattern.
- [Unsupported Content Placeholders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/unsupported_content_placeholders.md): Placeholder rendering for unsupported content like WMF images and math equations: enabling, HTML output, CSS styling, and TypeScript enum.
- [WASM Packaging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/wasm-packaging.md): How the browser WASM payload is built, trimmed, AOT-compiled, and compressed, with build scripts and measured size numbers.
- [WmlToHtmlConverter.cs - Gaps and Deficiencies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JSv4/Docxodus/main/docs/architecture/wml_to_html_converter_gaps.md): Known gaps and limitations in WmlToHtmlConverter, with resolved items marked and their implemented solutions.
